meta.coveragePolicy: Every current Golf tournament key is checked with the free ParlayAPI /odds/coverage endpoint. Paid /odds is called only for keys reporting current pregame Pinnacle outright coverage.
meta.probabilityPolicy: Only complete multi-player Pinnacle outright fields with at least four priced selections are accepted. Each selection is de-vigged against the full quoted field.
meta.settlementPolicy: Golf is sportsbook-probability only for launch. A disappearing quote, tournament progress, leaderboard position, withdrawal or result is never used to infer HIT/MISS.
